messages:
Elaine: @maria FYI StellarPay wants Wavefront-21B (FP16) on Redwood Dedicated next week. They asked for 99th p99 latency < 120ms and cost target < $0.002/token. Can you take point on feasibility and quick triage?

maria: on it. can you drop the customer perf samples + sample prompt mix?

Elaine: pasted sample prompt mix in thread (short transactions + chat + embeddings). top-level: 60% short chat, 30% transaction prompts (avg 48 tokens), 10% long context (2-3k). Also attaching current ONNX artifact link: s3://stellarpay/wavefront-21b/fp16/2026-03-18/

sam: @maria FYI Dedicated pool has A100 80GB nodes free Friday. If quantization needed we'd want to try 4-bit QAT on a subset first. p99 target might be tight for 21B with long context.

maria: quick smoke I ran (local):
```
run_eval --model wavefront-21b --dtype fp16 --batch 1 --seq 512 --prompt-sample-file /tmp/stellar_samples.json
```
baseline: avg latency 85ms/token, p99 190ms for seq512, mem headroom ~60GB. Evals: perplexity slightly higher vs reference (∆PPL +1.6). I pushed quant candidate q4+g to s3://redwood-temp/wave_q4_candidates/01

quant-bot: automated smoke results for q4 candidate: pass(topology), fail(accuracy) on fraud-classification eval set: AUC drop 0.03. Speedup ~1.6x for seq512. Details: https://ci.redwood/quant/2178001234

maria: sounds like we need 1) focused eval on fraud set to measure regression across prompts 2) try q3/ptq hybrid 3) check KV cache memory tradeoffs. @sam can you reserve one A100 for q4 tuning Friday AM?

sam: reserved node r-a100-07 for Fri 09:00-13:00 PT. tagging eng-infra to set up dev subnet.

Elaine: StellarPay says timeline is soft but they'd be impressed by a Friday demo. @tim_stellarpay can you confirm if they'd accept a small accuracy regression if latency improves 1.5x?

tim_stellarpay: quick answer — acceptable if regression ≤ 0.02 AUC and we flag in release notes. Priority: high. :thumbsup:

maria: plan: (a) run targeted eval suite overnight (fraud + chat coh) (b) attempt q3 hybrid candidate Fri morning, (c) produce short ship doc with fallback policy (fp16 -> q4 -> fp16) and rollout canary config. I'll post results here and open SR for Dedicated capacity change if numbers look good.

Elaine: thanks — please also include cost delta calc (tokens/sec, $/k tokens) and a suggested canary percentage. :eyes:

maria: got it, will upload artifacts + metrics by 2026-03-19 08:00 PT.

quant-bot: scheduled nightly eval job: job_id=QJOB-7821, expected finish 2026-03-19T07:45:00Z

sam: tagging @eng-infra and dropped a short checklist: 1) node reserve, 2) mount s3 artifacts, 3) enable perf tracing, 4) isolate customer VPC for demo. will follow up on infra channel.

Elaine: perfect, closing loop here. will coordinate customer comms after your upload. :white_check_mark:
